patch_description: Combines the soft-min subgradient ascent from the current program with the 16-direction pattern-search refinement stage from the higher-scoring crossover parent (0.49 vs 0.21), and adds a multi-start loop over several deterministic initializations (varying ring radii/jitters) with the best result kept. The pattern-search stage directly optimizes the true min-triangle objective and is the key contributor to the better score; the multi-start helps escape the poor local optimum that limited the parent. All randomness is seeded for determinism.
